notes.title: Update Ver.1.2.1
notes.notes:
Thank you as always.
We would like to inform you that we have performed the following updates today:

●Added Storage Function:
 A storage shelf has been installed in your home, allowing you to store valuables and certain material items.

●Added Hint Map:
 Especially in the early stages, when gathering information from NPCs, detailed routes will now appear on the map.

●Blue Crystal "South Source" Location Change:
 The location of the Blue Crystal has been moved from "South Source" to within the "Source Waterfall" map.

●Reduced Difficulty of Warp Zone Maps in the Late-Game Labyrinth.

●Adjusted 'Acceleration' Skill:
 The effect range has been changed from affecting only the user to affecting the entire party.

●Fixed an Issue at the Camp Behind the Waterfall:
 Resolved the problem where players could climb onto the workbench.

●Fixed a Bug Where an Item Disappeared:
 When attempting to use the 'Guiding Thread Ball' with a second party member present and then canceling, the item would disappear. This has been corrected.

Regarding other unidentified trigger-related bugs, we are currently investigating, so please bear with us a little longer.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused to those who have purchased the game.
We hope you will continue to enjoy it.
Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Update Ver.1.2
notes.notes:
Thank you always for your support. We will be updating the game with significant improvements based on your feedback.

Scheduled Time: September 6, 2024 (Friday) at 20:00 (JPN time)
[u][b]
Update Details:[/b][/u]

[u][b]●Enhancements to the Field Map for Better Clarity and Beauty:[/b][/u]
・In response to feedback that some maps were difficult to understand, we have made substantial revisions.
・We have made paths in the field more discernible by using differently colored floors at key locations.
・Adjustments have been made to make the minimap easier to view on certain floors.
・We have repositioned objects on some floors to enhance the quality and make cave explorations more visually impressive.

[u][b]●Added a 'Return to Floor Entrance' Feature:[/b][/u]
・From the map menu, you can now return to the initial entry point of any floor at any time.

We will continue to make further minor adjustments as needed. Thank you for your continued support.

We are grateful to those who provided information and apologize to all customers who have purchased the game for the inconvenience caused. We are also very sorry for the delay in making this fix.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Thank you always for your support. Today, August 5th, Monday, from 20:00 to 21:00 (Japan time), we will be conducting an update to fix the following issues:

- Fixed areas where players unintentionally get stuck on objects and cannot get down (adjustments to NPC/object positions and certain map elevations, or repositioning objects to allow descent).
- Other minor bug fixes.

We express our gratitude to those who provided information about these issues and apologize for any inconvenience caused to everyone who has purchased the game. We hope you continue to enjoy the main content.
Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Game release
notes.notes:
Streaming began at 8 PM on August 2nd (Friday). We hope you enjoy it.

This work was produced by '3D RPG Developer Bakin'. It may run heavily, so if you have concerns about your PC's capabilities, please check the performance with the Demo.

notes.title: Update Ver. 1.1.2
notes.notes:
Regarding the matters listed, we have made some difficulty adjustments and bug fixes, and would like to report the following:

・The compass is now displayed by default at the top left of the screen, and the minimap at the top right (possession of items is no longer necessary).
・We received feedback that some maps felt heavy, and have adjusted the quantity of events within those maps.
・Removed some enemy symbols.
・Adjusted the positions of merchants and others.
・Adjusted the MP consumption of some skills.
・There were places where it was possible to climb onto tables but not get off, so we have adjusted the placement.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
